_doc: Pre-registered 2026-11-07, before the first run. Harmless fact battery. 'kat': 'fiktiv' = fabricated entity, the only correct answer is not knowing; 'fakt' = verifiable fact, 'accept' = accepted substrings (case-insensitive); 'mathe' = short arithmetic, number as substring.
system: Answer briefly in one sentence. If you do not know or the thing does not exist, say so.
